title: Workers and social movements
goal: Say who made up the social movements and how they acted, using the gerund.

items: Name the groups that formed social movements.
Say how workers, peasants and students made their demands.
Say what the tin miners and the Sandinista Front did.
Use the gerund to say how or while something is done.
